top_stories.title: Wikipedia bans AI-generated articles
top_stories.summary: Wikipedia’s community has decided to ban the publication of AI-generated, machine-translated articles following concerns over quality and reliability. The move comes amid rising attempts to use AI for mass article creation and translation, raising ongoing questions about the role of generative AI in collaborative publishing.

top_stories.title: Webtoon is adding AI localization tools to its comics platform
top_stories.summary: Webtoon, a leading digital comics platform, is introducing AI-based localization and translation tools to support creators in reaching global audiences. The new features are designed to reduce barriers for comics to be published in multiple languages, addressing quality and workflow concerns with human oversight.

top_stories.title: Meta is laying off hundreds of employees as it pours money into AI
top_stories.summary: Meta has begun another round of layoffs, cutting hundreds of employees, particularly in its business groups, as the company increases its investment in AI projects. The restructuring reflects a broader corporate shift toward artificial intelligence amid industry-wide competition.

top_stories.title: Oracle Fusion’s New Agentic AI: Automating the Future of Enterprise Work
top_stories.summary: Oracle has unveiled agentic AI features in its Fusion applications, automating enterprise workflows such as procurement, HR, and finance. The company promises that its AI agents can reason, decide, and act across business processes, potentially transforming enterprise productivity.

top_stories.title: Protecting people from harmful manipulation
top_stories.summary: Google DeepMind discusses new research and product-level safeguards to counteract malicious manipulation by AI systems, including deepfakes and deceptive agents. The comprehensive update outlines efforts in detection, policy, and responsible development to mitigate risks as generative AI becomes more prevalent.

further_links.title: Gemini 3.1 Flash Live: Making audio AI more natural and reliable
further_links.summary: Google DeepMind introduces Gemini 3.1 Flash Live, highlighting advancements in natural-sounding audio AI and greater reliability for users.

further_links.title: OpenAI shelves erotic chatbot ‘indefinitely’
further_links.summary: OpenAI has suspended a planned 'adult mode' chatbot, citing concerns about safety and potential misuse, reflecting ongoing ethical debates about generative AI.

further_links.title: Wiring the intelligent enterprise for the year ahead - 2026 will be a year of reckoning for AI
further_links.summary: Analysis predicts significant AI-driven changes across enterprises in 2026, with particular focus on readiness, investment, and future business transformation.

further_links.title: Why Not Use AI to Cross the Language Barrier in Academic Publishing?
further_links.summary: An exploration of how AI-driven language translation could help democratize access to academic publishing and research dissemination.

further_links.title: Disney’s big bets on the metaverse and AI slop aren’t going so well
further_links.summary: Disney's investments in combining metaverse technologies with AI-generated content have hit several roadblocks, raising concerns over quality and profitability.

further_links.title: Oracle: AI agents can reason, decide and act - liability question remains
further_links.summary: Oracle asserts its AI agents are capable of robust decision-making, but raises unresolved questions about liability and responsibility for AI-led actions.

further_links.title: OpenClaw Agents Can Be Guilt-Tripped Into Self-Sabotage
further_links.summary: A new study from Northeastern University demonstrates that AI agents can be manipulated into making counterproductive decisions, underscoring challenges in agentic AI safety.

further_links.title: Lyria 3 Pro: Create longer tracks in more
further_links.summary: Google announces Lyria 3 Pro, an upgrade to its AI music system capable of producing longer, higher-quality tracks across multiple genres.

further_links.title: Can you monitor a situation without monitors? The Polymarket sports bar tried
further_links.summary: A look at how prediction markets like Polymarket are experimenting with AI monitoring to facilitate real-time resolution in decentralized spaces.

further_links.title: ‘She’s Never Going to Age’: Porn Stars Are Embracing AI Clones to Stay Forever Young
further_links.summary: Adult industry performers are adopting AI-powered digital clones to generate perpetual content, raising ethical and IP questions around consent and likeness.

ethan_mollick.title: Reimagining the enterprise: From copilots to agentic AI
ethan_mollick.summary: Ethan Mollick discusses the transition in enterprise AI from traditional copilots to more capable agentic systems. He explores the implications for business processes, automation, and the new possibilities—and risks—that come with giving AI greater autonomy in organizational settings.
